name: boson-explore
description: Design-space and power exploration skills for the boson EDA toolchain — sweep RTL parameters and clock periods through boson's synthesis/place/STA/power flow, get back an area/power/timing tradeoff table, render the whole sweep as an animated PPA video (terminal replay + Pareto scatter + placements), or close timing at a target clock with the cheapest optimisation recipe that works.
